text:
julie.support: Heads up — several EU customers hitting intermittent 503s and 200-400ms tail latencies since ~08:12Z. All affected requests appear to be routed to us-east even though eu-west pool healthy. Cookie shows `region=eu`, but response header `X-Region-Routed: us-east`. Anyone seen this? cc @sam.sre @ryan.eng

alex.k: Can you paste a quick repro curl + headers (no PII)?

julie.support: repro curl:  
```
curl -v 'https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' \
  -H 'X-Client-Region: eu' \
  -H 'Cookie: region=eu; session=abc123' \
  --data '{"input":"hello"}'
```  
response headers: `HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable`, `X-Region-Routed: us-east`, `X-Gateway-Route: default-fallback`. Snippet from proxy log: `2026-05-03T08:12:14Z gw-router[info] affinity_lookup: miss -> fallback to default-pool // routed to us-east`.

sam.sre: Looking at the gateway logs for that timespan we see a pattern: the L7 steering does a route lookup, gets `route_affinity: hit` then immediately `affinity_staleness` for same session -> triggers fallback path. I suspect an affinity-table expiry vs cookie TTL race introduced by the latest routing fallback change. Log lines: `affinity_table: expired(session=abc123) -> fallback`.

mira.s: Any deploys around that time?

deploy-bot: deploy gw-router v2.14.1 to prod completed at 2026-05-03T08:06:40Z by ci/pipeline #8321

ryan.eng: v2.14.1 included the new `route_affinity_fallback` behavior (tries default pool on mismatch). Repro locally: curl with `Cookie: region=eu;session=abc123` against staging gw-router v2.14.1 shows header rewrite dropping `X-Region-Hint` in upstream request, which makes auth/backend choose default (us-east). Quick config snippet:  
```
route_config: {
  retry_policy: ...,
  route_affinity_fallback: true,  # changed in v2.14.1
  header_action: rewrite_on_fallback: true
}
```

julie.support: Customers report billing spike due to cross-region egress and high latency — this is impacting SLAs. Need ETA for mitigation or rollback.

sam.sre: Short-term mitigation: push a gateway header rule to preserve `X-Region-Hint` and `Cookie: region` on fallback (prevent rewrite), or disable `route_affinity_fallback` for EU routes. I can push an emergency config to EU edge in ~10m if we agree. This avoids full code rollback.

ryan.eng: I'll prepare a PR to revert the fallback behavior in the router code, but that takes longer. For now I support the emergency config tweak. Also we should add a metric to catch `affinity_staleness->fallback` spikes.

alex.k: Do we have a list of affected customer IDs/events so we can notify them and assess billing impact?

julie.support: Affected: cust-834, cust-912, cust-210. All incidents starting 2026-05-03T08:12Z. Sample auth error observed in logs after route switch: `auth: token_aud_mismatch( expected="eu-auth", got="us-east-auth" )` — so auth sometimes fails when route flips.

sam.sre: Escalating to auth team as well, auth needs to allow cross-region validation or gateway must preserve region hint during routing. @ryan.eng do you want us to go ahead with emergency header preserve?
ryan.eng: Ack. Please apply preserve-header patch to eu edge and monitor. I'll open INCIDENT INC-2026-045 and start rollback PR.

deploy-bot: Incident INC-2026-045 created by ryan.eng at 2026-05-03T08:20:05Z

mira.s: Julie, can you collect one HAR / full request trace from an affected user and drop into #support-uploads so we have exact headers and cookie order?

julie.support: Uploading HAR now. Also adding customer logs and sample tcpdump. Will follow up once push completes. :thumbsup:

sam.sre: Monitoring: after header-preserve applied (10:35Z) early signs of routing normalizing to eu-west and 503s dropping. Keeping the emergency rule until we ship the code revert.

ryan.eng: Thanks team. Follow-ups: 1) Roll out fix PR to remove aggressive fallback, 2) add unit for affinity TTL vs cookie TTL, 3) add alert for `affinity_fallback_rate > 0.5%`.

julie.support: Notified affected customers, created billing review ticket for cross-region egress. I'll update once customers confirm improved latency.

alex.k: Nice work. Keep updates brief in this thread.
